properties.label: Handled revision-slip trio
properties.text: Rest three small paper documents on a warm desk-like ground, using slight rotation differences and offset crop corners; each contains a revision code, narrow title and short note.

properties.label: Narrow revision-slip serif
properties.text: Set each slip's title in a narrow serif and keep its revision code and note clearly readable.

properties.label: Cream, gold and charcoal
properties.text: Use warm cream #f2efe8, ivory sheets, muted gold registration marks and charcoal ink.

properties.label: Lifted paper corners
properties.text: Model a subtle lifted corner, fine outer edge and soft directional contact shadow on the paper, keeping texture secondary to type.

properties.label: Still editorial arrangement
properties.text: Keep the arrangement still and retain all three slips at narrow widths rather than removing one to fit a poster height.

properties.label: Paper and shadow acceptance
properties.text: Ensure rotations do not clip a sheet or blur reading text, then compare paper edges and shadow direction at full scale.
